TOUHOUANCIENTS-WATARI_NINA_ANCIENT.title: Nina Watari
TOUHOUANCIENTS-WATARI_NINA_ANCIENT.epith: Information Youkai Obsessed with the Sts
Could you be the ones constantly advancing toward the top of the tower, the so-called [sine]"Spire Players"[/sine]?
Ooh! Just as the rumors said...
Actually, the whole thing about you going to find the Architect was all Neow’s...
Question
Oh?! Are you sure you want to hear it? This hidden [sine]truth of the world[/sine]? The secrets of heaven must not be revealed...
Heheh, I am the omniscient one. There’s nothing in this entire Spire that I, Nina Watari, don’t know!
The future of the world we live in is decided in the shadows by a small handful of people. This is the absolute truth!
Hey, can you do that thing, yeah that thing—"Dark Embrace + Corruption + Dropkick + Replay Demon Form, and then all my cards are exhausted, what do I play?!"
I heard you’re really good at shuffling. Is that true?
Respond
I enter!!!
Pondering
I enter!!!
Ooh! The legendary fourth-strongest character of the Sts!
Continue
[i][font_size=22]<Angry beep>[/font_size][/i]
You sure boot up fast! Back here already, huh!
Wow! A purple character! Could you be that figure who only appears in [sine]legends[/sine]?!!
Oh ho! So you’re that famous Hieda family... "Achoo!" from the village? Heheh, you’ve reincarnated pretty fast!
Continue
...I’ll write you into the Gensokyo Chronicles.
Why does your profile picture often appear in outside memes?
I've come across plenty of turkey pictures modeled after you in the currents of information.
Anger
That bastard——————————
You really do lack common sense. When we get back, I'll have you attend my class.
Continue
Ehh—you're trying to feed me false history, aren't you!!
TOUHOUANCIENTS-KOTIYA_SANAE_ANCIENT.talk: Ah, so you’re the puppet that the two ladies mentioned? I am Sanae, the wind priestess. Your journey has been so arduous—why not come pray at the [aqua][jitter]Moriya Shrine[/jitter][/aqua] and wash away all your pain and fatigue?
Even in this tower, you can’t be bound by common sense.
If I could go subdue the monsters in the tower too, that might be fun... Ah, Lady Kanako mustn’t hear that!
Lady Suwako says that helping you can gather faith, so you’d better do your best too~
Where should I go to spread the word next?
No matter what motives a worshipper may have, they’re all useful to the shrine!
Fufu~ We can’t let the Hakurei Shrine hog all the benefits! Moriya’s support is every bit as good as hers!
Such an evil aura! Are you possessed by something? A demon? That’s terrible! You should come have faith in our [aqua][jitter]Moriya Shrine[/jitter][/aqua]!
Uwoooh! A robot that can walk on its own!
Continue
[i][font_size=22]<Confused beep>[/font_size][/i]
Continue
A giant humanoid robot is a human dream! Nothing could be better!
A worshipper who looks both exhausted and with dangerous aura? How long has it been since you last rested?
Respond
Continue
Take a rest. And while you’re at it, you could pay a visit to our [aqua][jitter]Moriya Shrine[/jitter][/aqua]! Maybe a miraculous stroke of luck will come your way.
Huh?!?! An alien?! Well, I guess it’s not that strange for aliens to exist in this world?
A skeleton... and a hand? Come to think of it, if the hand also prays, would that be double the faith?
Sneer
Faith? If faith could help me achieve that [jitter][font_size=22][purple]long-cherished wish[/purple][/font_size][/jitter], I would be as devout as needed.
Continue
Well, miracles are merely the pinnacle of coincidence. Their outcome could be good or bad, you know.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-HAKUREI_REIMU_ANCIENT.epi: Mysterious Shrine Maiden of the Spire
TOUHOUANCIENTS-HAKUREI_REIMU_ANCIENT.tal: A visitor? Ah... heading to the top of the tower, huh. Take some stuff and go. If you could make an offering, even better.
Hurry up and deal with the trouble at the top so [u]she’ll let me go back to Gensokyo for some tea.
Hmph, if it weren’t for [u]her[/u]... I’d have gone and dealt with the trouble myself.
[i][font_size=22]<Confused yawn>[/font_size][/i]
That whole "effort will be rewarded" thing is just boring preaching.
A rundown place like this barely gets any worshippers—just annoying bugs and a chattering blue bird freak. I can barely scrape together any offering money at all.
I’m warning you—don’t cause trouble here.
You’ve got some bigshot backing you too? Tsk, this world is hopeless.
Is believing in a demon even considered faith? If you’re visiting a shrine, at least show some reverence.
Hey now, I don’t welcome rude constructs here!
Show goodwill
[i][font_size=22]<Frightened beep>[/font_size][/i]
Continue
...Turns out you’re a normal one. Fine, I’ll make an exception and host you just this once.
If you need a repairman, it’s not like you have to go to that Architect guy. Ah, whatever, I won’t stop you if you want to go.
Here, take this—once you’ve fixed your friend, remember to come back here and pay your respects.
Stop lurking around over there, I can see you. Come on out—you’re scaring away the worshippers!
Show yourself
(The Silent steps out from the shadows)
Continue
All sorts of shady characters keep showing up... If you’re heading to the top, take this and leave quickly, or I’ll kick you out.
I didn’t invite you. Help yourself to whatever, just don’t get in the way of my sweeping.
Another weirdo... grab your stuff and leave. It’s right next to the offering box.
Look
Continue
[i][font_size=22]The Regent tosses a handful of gold coins into the offering box.[/font_size][/i]
Continue
[jitter]Oooh!!! Sir! You are far too generous! You are the most generous person in the whole world—no, the entire universe![/jitter]
Proud
Heh, this is what a king ought to do!
Oh, it’s you. Welcome, welcome. Make yourself at home, I’ll go make some tea.
Your manners are so much better than those youkai. As a token of thanks for your continued patronage, please take this.
...Fine, a skeleton is still better than no one coming to pray.
Offer a prayer
(Whispering) Father, please bless me as I avenge you.
Continue
...Take what you need. May the gods watch over you on your journey.
...Don’t you ever get tired of butting in?
Since you've already set off, just see the job through to the end.
It's a delight to meet the Hakurei Shrine Maiden here.
Continue
Ahh—truth be told... rather than sitting here waiting for someone else to settle things, I'd rather take care of them myself... that's more my style.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-REMILIA_SCARLET_ANCIENT.t: Remilia Scarlet
Welcome to the Scarlet Devil Mansion~ I am the mistress of this estate, Remilia Scarlet. Allow my maid to introduce you to the magnificent treasures within.
Heheh, our fates converge once again.
The power of a vampire can easily twist fate, you know.
Another guest for my afternoon tea party. Sakuya, remember to prepare an extra serving.
Back again? ...Perhaps this time, your fate will be different.
The monsters here are dreadfully dull. Can you bring me something more interesting to talk about?
An assassin has appeared in the mansion? Looks like Meiling is slacking off again.
Respond
Continue
Your compatibility with vampires seems quite good, but you are still lacking in power. Would you like to take a treasure with you?
My, speaking of daggers, the one here in our house is quite skilled too. Would you like to have a match with her?
Respond
Continue
(Sakuya: Please just use the word maid.)
Pfft—why does this black tea taste salty!
Continue
That is only natural here, is it not?
You have quite a lot of minions.
Continue
Because fate has brought us together.
Thinking
My minions should learn from yours.
Ah—a skeleton witch! What an interesting visitor. Perhaps Patchouli will find plenty in common with you.
Oh my, long time no see! Our Patchouli has missed you, heheh.
(Patchouli: You talk too much.)
Greeting
(The NecroBinder and Patchouli exchange magical knowledge.)
Continue
As thanks for chatting with our Patchouli, take this with you.
You and your... family seem to get along so well.
Continue
Family... is it? Yes, we’re a family that gets along very well.
Continue
I’m a little envious.
Demon... slaughter...
Continue
Oh my, you must have mistaken me for someone else? After all, a vampire as [sine]dignified[/sine] as myself is quite rare~
A robot? I’ve never tried reversing a robot’s fate before.
Koakuma? What are you doing here? No wonder Patchouli couldn’t find you. Ah—you’re not heading for the top of the tower, are you?
Continue
Ahem, Lady Remilia, please keep this from Lady Patchouli…
TOUHOUANCIENTS-KOMEJI_SATORI_ANCIENT.epi: The Maiden Whom Even the Blight Fears
TOUHOUANCIENTS-KOMEJI_SATORI_ANCIENT.tal: ...A visitor? How rare. I am Satori. I know your purpose. Take these things and head to the top of the tower...
I can hear everything in your heart...
We meet again. Ah... I see, you don’t remember anything? But making you remember would be against the rules...
Heheh, would you like to borrow the power of my third eye? Mind-reading is the most wonderful ability in this world...
Inside your heart... there’s another voice?
Silence
...I see, it’s that demon... Tsk. How unpleasant.
(The demon grins wickedly) Mind-reading youkai, can you read my thoughts?
Continue
...Even mind-reading has its limits, let alone in a case of possession like yours.
Continue
(A burst of hearty, maniacal laughter)
Continue
However, I can read this warrior’s desire to tear you limb from limb...
Your heart is filled with far too many malicious mental remnants.
Reply
...I feel like someone’s said something similar before.
Continue
"We would share the same paint if you knew what’s befallen me." Too bad... witnessing your ordeal is hardly a pleasant experience.
Are you thirsty? Shall I prepare some tea?
Question
Hey! Who are you muttering to? But well, I, the Regent, do need some supplies...
Continue
"This one truly knows some royal etiquette." Heheh, it’s my honor to have pleased Your Highness...[sine](laugh)[/sine]
Annoyed
What’s with that look on your face?
Respond
Continue
Respond
Continue
(Sigh) Alright, alright... I mean you no harm... Please stop imagining [jitter][red]bloody scenes[/red][/jitter] of me being killed by you in your mind.
Continue
[i][font_size=22]<Curious beep>[/font_size][/i]
Continue
Ugh... I really can’t read a robot’s thoughts after all...
TOUHOUANCIENTS-HINANAWI_TENSHI_ANCIENT.t: Tenshi Hinanawi
Hey, you over there, look here! I’ve got something good for you! Take it with gratitude!
Celestials are beings who occasionally descend to the earth to offer advice. But—for me—they’re all just impractical advice anyway.
Life in the heavens is so boring. Watching you all climb the spire makes me want to go in myself!
Hey, where’d that Iku girl run off to?
If you can tolerate things yet things won’t tolerate you, what then? If you cannot tolerate yourself, who will tolerate you?
Hey, want me to condescend to have a drink with you? I’m not bragging, but even oni can’t outdrink me. Believe it?
High rank and wealth are not part of one’s true nature—they are but borrowed things that come by chance.
Neither might nor power can bend one’s will! Hey, can you hear me?
Love all alike and benefit each other. Robot, remember the celestial’s teachings!
Attempt to translate
[i][font_size=22]<Confused beep>[/font_size][/i]
I’m so jealous of robots and their ability to store knowledge in what’s it called... a hard drive! Then I wouldn’t have to bother cramming all those ancient texts into my head!
Hmph, foolish earthling. How could such pathetic poison harm my tempered celestial body? However, I’m magnanimous enough to forgive you—I’ll still give you whatever you want!
To enjoy life, one must treasure contentment over greed.
The bird sings out, seeking a friend’s reply. Shouldn’t you sometimes let down your guard and cooperate with others?
If you want to improve your coordination with that hand, your strategic thinking should learn from the flow of water. Adaptability is the key to victory.
When two are of one heart, their sharpness can cut through metal. I acknowledge you!
Bear no past grudges, and resentment will fade. Don’t let hatred cloud your mind!
Ooh! You say you’re from outer space? Space... isn’t that a higher realm than the heavens? Wait, doesn’t that make you a celestial above celestials?!
Hahahaha! To meet a kindred spirit as noble and wise as yourself—this journey was truly worth it!
Cheers
Lady Tenshi’s knowledge and capacity for drink are truly admirable! Minions, bring larger cups!
Continue
Ha! Perhaps we should become partners and raise a ruckus here, showing those commoners the power of a celestial and a prince!
As heaven’s movement is vigorous, a gentleman should strive to constantly strengthen himself!
You’re a bit too straightforward sometimes. As they say, to be complete, one must learn to bend. Sometimes you have to take detours for life to be fulfilling.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-INABA_TEWI_ANCIENT.title: Tewi Inaba
TOUHOUANCIENTS-INABA_TEWI_ANCIENT.talk.f: Heheh, visitors just keep coming and going here. Since you’re here, how about taking a bit of my luck with you~
TOUHOUANCIENTS-INABA_TEWI_ANCIENT.talk.A: Heheh, we meet again. How was the gift you took from me last time? Want to try again? And... have you brought any return gift?
This tower is a maze that bewitches people. Getting lost is something only the living do, you know.
Heheh! Make sure to patronize that mask merchant’s business more often~ Kickbacks? Heheh, what are you talking about?
The timing of luck is like a market deal—hesitate even a little, and its value drops.
The rabbits have found quite a few treasures again. You might as well take some along~
Meeting me is like the luck of buying a tent at the very first shop when you set out~
TOUHOUANCIENTS-INABA_TEWI_ANCIENT.talk.I: Heheh, don’t look at me like that. Do I really look like a rabbit trying to trick you~? At least I’m much more honest than that [red]demon[/red], right?
TOUHOUANCIENTS-INABA_TEWI_ANCIENT.talk.S: My, your poison is quite potent. If Madam hadn’t prepared plenty of antidotes, my cute underlings would be in big trouble.
Well, I know someone who’s a master at making medicine. Not just antidotes—they can make any kind of drug. Heheh, shall I introduce you sometime?
TOUHOUANCIENTS-INABA_TEWI_ANCIENT.talk.R: Oh my, if it isn’t Lord Regent, who’s been all over the news lately. How rude of me~ Is there anything my underlings can do for you?
Hey, these are luminous bamboo from the bamboo forest—a local specialty. If you bring them back to your planet, they’re sure to draw many envious glances~
Hmm... I need to carefully assess my current assets.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-INABA_TEWI_ANCIENT.talk.N: Undead one, the rabbits all scatter far away when they see you and that hand of yours.
There’s someone I must kill. What can you do to help me?
Revenge, is it... Heheh, then take this with you~
TOUHOUANCIENTS-INABA_TEWI_ANCIENT.talk.D: Even a robot can become lucky if you do as I say, you know?
TOUHOUANCIENTS-INABA_TEWI_ANCIENT.talk.M: Oh my—I can’t believe I get to see you~ I thought you hadn’t come along with the others.
Heheh, that’s not like you. Wait? My luck isn’t responsible for waiting around.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-INABA_TEWI_ANCIENT.talk.A: Heheh. Young mistress of the Human Village, what brings you all the way here?
Oh my, Lord Enma is so cold-hearted. Working even a body like yours to the bone.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-INABA_TEWI_ANCIENT.talk.M: Heheh, running into an old acquaintance.
If you’re here, that means she’s here too—
Mm hm~ Is she here~? I wonder if the princess would allow me to tell you~
For the sake of a thousand years as neighbors, pick any fine treasure you like~
TOUHOUANCIENTS-KIJIN_SEIJA_ANCIENT.title: Seija Kijin
Puppet of Neow, join our rebel army! Whether it’s the Architect or Neow, we will topple them all!
How much longer will you let Neow deceive you? Take this, kill the Architect, then go settle the score with her too!
Heheh, in this tower, rampaging magical power is endless—bringing any number of items to life is no problem at all!
Take these awakened items and turn this world upside down!
That princess... she insists on going to take down the Architect herself. I just can’t do anything with her...
Hmph, those Mazaleth worshippers are nothing but narrow-minded frogs in a well. You’ve got more ambition than them, don’t you?
Join me in the revolt from below—
What’s the sage’s scheme, bringing everyone here? Hah, whatever. My rebellion and upheaval will never stop, no matter where I am!
Another puppet of Neow has arrived. I hope you’re someone who can understand the situation.
Continue
Architect... slaughter...
Continue
Good. Let you repay the Architect tenfold for the pain and humiliation we have suffered!

I already know about the Great Demon. Hmph, I despise high-and-mighty rulers like that. When you raise the banner of rebellion against that Great Demon, my rebel army and I will stand by you from the very start!
You cruel tyrant! Look at what you’ve done to the little people beneath your throne!
Confused
You mean my minions? They have no complaints. Besides, I created them—I have the final say in everything.
Continue
Hah! Boring excuse! I’ll be here waiting for the day your little people overthrow you!
Pondering
Hmm... Until then, can you spare some help to get me up there?
Alien, we meet again!
Continue
I forgive your rudeness. So, on top of all this, can you scrounge up some more useful items for me?
Continue
Hmph, since you put it that way... I suppose it’s not entirely out of the question...
Continue
But I refuse! One of my favorite things to do, Seija Kijin, is saying "NO" to those who think they’re so tough!
I’m different from that demon who only knows how to set traps in contracts. An amanojaku never tries to manipulate you—every word I say is gospel. Can you argue with that?
Good. I like that cold, merciless look in your eyes—like everything is prey. You’re a born rebel.
Respond
... *(brandishes a dagger)*
Continue
Wait, wait... I’ll give you what you want, how can you point your blade at your own allies?
Seems like you don’t have many friends. Heheh, don’t worry—those who do great things are naturally alone.
Interested in making your dagger move on its own? Give them a throat, and they shall speak.
This lady seems to carry quite a grudge. Heheh, did the Architect do something to you?
Anger
[jitter]He killed everything I love!!![/jitter]
Continue
Good. Rebellion and revolution need determination like yours...
You want to see the power of the Malleus Malleus? Hah, though what’s the princess’s is mine... but its magic is unstable right now. I don’t want to incur too much of a cost yet.
Reply
I don’t mind paying the cost myself.
Continue
Since you said that, now I’m definitely not letting you use it! We’ll see when the princess gets back. Try something else for now...
Heh, seems like necromancy is a better way to bring in new recruits than waiting for items to turn into tsukumogami...
Huh? I didn’t summon any constructs! Are broken constructs moving on their own now?
Continue
[i][font_size=22]<Confused beep>[/font_size][/i]
Continue
So it has a will of its own... It seems tsukumogami-fication of constructs is a promising research direction.
Repair you? Hmph, there were once [jitter]tools[/jitter] that woke up thanks to my magic, got their own bodies, and immediately ran off—then came back to hunt me! I’m not falling for that again!
You’ve got quite a lot of potential in you—you’re bound for great things. So join my rebel army right now!
TOUHOUANCIENTS-MEDICINE_MELANCHOLY_ANCIE: Medicine Melancholy
Little Lonely Medicine
Lily, someone’s come to the flower field...
This flower field is being invaded by mean bugs... Take my magic and go wipe out those wretched insects!
There are still so many construct friends who haven’t awakened their hearts... We must liberate them!
This journey must be full of thorns! Come lie down in the lily-of-the-valley field for a bit, just for a bit...
It’s the season for lilies-of-the-valley to grow! Let the Lilys bloom vibrantly throughout the tower!
You’re just like a hero from a story! Who’s the big bad demon lord this time?
...Huh? You want to kill Father? No no! You should go defeat the demon instead!
Wake up, hero! Everyone’s using you!
You don’t seem to be feeling well?
Respond
Continue
Go find Father at the top of the tower—he can definitely make an antidote!
Father hates rude guests, so this time... why not try talking to him nicely?
Your little snake is so cute. I want to tie a tiny bow on it!
This poison called Blight on you... Lily and I have never seen such a potent poison before...
I have arrived! Let me see the residents here... Where are the people?
Continue
Hey—I’m right here—
Crouch down
Such a small little one! So happy to exchange gifts with you.
Your friends look so tired...
Respond
My minions willingly fight for a great cause.
Continue
Are they happy? Then maybe it’s okay!
Tell me more about your stories! Lily wants to hear too!
...Maybe I should consider dressing up my minions a bit...
You look like that lazy old shinigami!
Respond
If it can grant his death, I gladly become a loathsome existence.
Continue
If only you could defeat all the bad guys!
Can skeletons enjoy desserts too? Well, I’ve prepared some for you and Big Hand anyway!
Your heart is completely corroded by poison!
Respond
Revenge is all that remains of my life.
Continue
Since we all die in the end, why not seek a little more happiness?
Wow, you’re a friend who also has a heart?
Respond
[i][font_size=22]<Joyful beep>[/font_size][/i]
Continue
Wonderful! If it’s you, I’m sure you can do it!
Why are you so fixated on repairing yourself? You finally got a true heart!
There are many abandoned children in the lily-of-the-valley field, all willing to become part of your parts!
TOUHOUANCIENTS-KIRISAME_MARISA_ANCIENT.t: Marisa Kirisame
Hey! First time meeting, I’m Marisa Kirisame, welcome to my Kirisame Magic Shop Da☆Ze! We’ve got all kinds of magic items here!
Take this! The most important thing in danmaku is firepower Da☆Ze!
There’s nothing that overwhelming firepower can’t solve!!
Don’t worry, all these are my magical creations! They’re not borrowed, you know!
Have you seen Reimu? Remember to say hi to her for me! This can be my thanks!
Lately the mushroom growth patterns here have been getting weirder and weirder...
Why would I help you? Hehe, because you’re all precious to me, Da☆Ze!
Ahh—when things break here, I have to fix them all myself! Kinda miss that Kourin...
What did the Architect even do to make you all want to kill him? Well, maybe I should go investigate myself sometime.
Why’s Neow hiding at the bottom of the tower? The stronger you are, the more you like to hide yourself away.
Let’s have a spectacular danmaku battle sometime Da☆Ze! I’ve still got that fight with Tanx fresh in my hands!
Granny Tezcatara’s hot cocoa and cookies were pretty good—too bad I’m a Washoku-ist Da☆Ze!
Heheh, that Orobas fella’s got plenty of shiny trinkets—what a haul!
That Darv guy’s collection is even bigger than mine! Darn, I lost this round!
Hey, have you met Nonupeipe? Her gifts are pretty nice and all... but I still feel a bit uneasy.
I didn’t even accept the [sine]The Secret God[/sine]’s invitation~ Who’d sign a contract with that evil-looking demon?
Oh—what fine armor, warrior! I wonder if you have any interest in magic!
Hey! I see you! If you want something, just tell me directly. No need to sneak around! When I go to the Scarlet Devil Mansion, I always walk right through the front door Da☆Ze!
A robot? Want to fix your friend? Hmm... I know someone who’s an [aqua]mechanical engineer[/aqua]. Maybe she can help Da☆Ze!
That [aqua]Nitori[/aqua], who knows what she’s busy with... Anyway, if I get the chance, I’ll introduce you to her.
Hey, what a rare visitor! I’ve made quite a lot of mushroom dishes. Want to join me?
Consider
Earthly cuisine... based on past experience, it leaves much to be desired as royal fare.
Continue
Hey, don’t be like that! I’m confident my mushroom cooking skills won’t disappoint you!
Necromancy? That’s dark magic Da☆Ze! Alice wouldn’t be happy to see that.
I’m quite interested in that grimoire of yours... Would you be willing to sell it?
Continue
Oh! Good eye! It might just be an ordinary little notebook, but it does contain all my experimental records and hard work so far!
Continue
I can’t sell it... but I don’t mind lending it to you for now Da☆Ze! Take this too while you’re at it!
Keine-sensei, you're here to investigate too? Heheh, there's no village to conceal or false moon around here, you know.
Kaguya Houraisan
Eternal Ancient Sinner
Greetings, and welcome to Eientei. Everything here has been granted eternity by my power. Feel free to take whatever you need.
Don’t expect rewards beyond what you’ve earned through your own labor, for that will surely bring misfortune.
Endlessly trying to reach the top of the tower, over and over again... that might be rather amusing too... heheh.
I’ve finally found something I want to do. I wonder if the udumbara flower will have bloomed by the time I return.
Too bad Preon doesn’t have such an ominous thing as the moon. I suppose there’ll be no chance to admire it.
That turkey... where is she now?
Have you seen my rabbit merchant downstairs? Heheh, don’t let her looks fool you—she’s quite sharp. Best not to fall into her trap.
Hmm... would Eirin say this counts as living a bit more fulfilled, I wonder?
I could add what I’ve gathered here to the Lunar Capital’s Banquet of Diversity. It’s not like Gensokyo folks can tell what’s actually from the Lunar anyway.

You’re drenched in blood and filth.
Killing the Architect won’t cleanse any of it.

A warrior of flame, coming back to life and standing before me time and again.
You remind me of someone annoying.
If you’re a once-in-a-century hero, can you find the treasures I seek and solve my riddles?
I need your secret treasure to destroy the Architect completely.
Continue
Oh my, it’s not impossible. Though your drive for revenge... it reminds me of someone.
Oh my, why the rush? Come in and sit for a while. I’ll have Inaba brew some tea.
Continue
I don’t want to waste a single second before killing him.
Continue
Time and history don’t flow forward here. Calm your fury and reason every now and then.
Awooo—aah, I’m alive. Your poison tastes terrible, you know.
Respond
Continue
I’m not actually angry about being poisoned to death? Out of all the deaths I’ve experienced, I’d rate it above average. Still, next time you poison someone, do give them a heads up first.
There is no antidote for Blight. Even Eirin would be stumped by this one.
An alien? Heheh, I too came from beyond Preon—from a planet called the moon.
I hear you’re the heir of the sun—a prince, then?
Proud
That’s right! I, the Regent, am the future [orange]King[/orange]!
Continue
In that case, would you consider proposing to me, the lunar princess? I could make an exception and let you skip my riddles~
Continue
W-What?!
Continue
Heheh, just a little joke~
Are you the Architect’s construct that Eirin mentioned? Come here, I’ll give you some treasures.
I’ve grown a bit bored of video games lately. How about learning some programming? Maybe I could be of help to you?
Continue
[i][font_size=22]<Joyful beep>[/font_size][/i]

TOUHOUANCIENTS-JUNKO_ANCIENT.title: Junko
TOUHOUANCIENTS-JUNKO_ANCIENT.talk.firstV: My name is Junko. Let me extend my hospitality to you, who have struggled so far to get here.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-JUNKO_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.0-: The journey through Preon is merely a tedious diversion in my life of vengeance.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-JUNKO_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.1-: My conflict with the Lunarians has reached a stalemate anyway. I’ve grown weary of it lately—coming here is actually not a bad choice.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-JUNKO_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.2-: I find the happenings here quite intriguing. Let me see more of it.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-JUNKO_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.3-: My sworn enemy, Chang’e... are you watching?
TOUHOUANCIENTS-JUNKO_ANCIENT.talk.IRONCL: Pure flames. An interesting Ironclad. I shall grant you power.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-JUNKO_ANCIENT.talk.SILENT: I see the killing intent in your eyes. Let it become even purer.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-JUNKO_ANCIENT.talk.REGENT: (Examining) No matter which planet you’re from, as long as it’s not the moon.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-JUNKO_ANCIENT.talk.DEFECT: Fear death, cherish life. Even a construct should be no exception. If you recognize the weight of your existence, accept my purest blessing.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-JUNKO_ANCIENT.talk.NECROB: I need help to kill him.
You have a sworn enemy too?
...This is the first time I’ve felt the heat of vengeful flames. Does it come from you?
I am the purest incarnation of vengeance.
No need for impatience, no need for fear. The opportunities and time for vengeance are limitless. [b]We[/b] have all the time we need.
The revenge drama will repeat for all eternity—be it yours, or mine.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-YORIGAMI_SISTER_ANCIENT.e: The Most-Despicable and Disastrous Blight God Sister
TOUHOUANCIENTS-YORIGAMI_SISTER_ANCIENT.t: We’re the Yorigami sisters who can make money even from crying children! Hehehe, if you want to get rich, now’s your best chance~
Bring out the most expensive booze——!
A toast to this brave champion of Neow!
The most fulfilling of lives is that in which you can [jitter][gold]buy anything![/gold][/jitter] Do you agree?
If you don’t agree, I will stare at you with a look of extreme disappointment...
How about I lend you my sister at a discount? Just let her possess the Boss, and they’ll get so unlucky they won’t even measure up to a minion~
Ah! I almost forgot! If I bring my sister along, you might not even make it to the Boss at all!
If we make a tidy bit of extra gold to bring back, we can not only pay off the last oil debt but turn a fat profit!
We can become rich gods again!
Joon... I feel like we haven’t made a penny since we got here... all the gold we found went to that mask merchant...
It’ll come, it’ll come! There are plenty of ways to make money! Besides, if we don’t spend it, it’ll disappear in your hands anyway~
I heard Lady Tenshi is here too. I was hoping she could help us find treasure chests... but that monster sheep... is lurking up there too...
Eek! That thing was after our oil last time, what’s it after now?
Oh well~ there’s always a way to make money, we can still get rich here~
Without the Dream World, complete possession is such a hassle...
Oh my, that’s terrible~ Big Sister’s only redeeming quality is gone too~
A sister with such a sharp tongue... makes me wish I didn’t have one...
Look here, look here! Who’s gonna be the next success story? You?
Don’t you dare leave me behind this time——
Ugh... this warrior looks like bad news...
Sis, what are you worried about? As long as we use that trick... there’s nobody we can’t beat.
Hey sis, don’t you think the essence of a demon contract is also a form of possession?
Dammit, at this rate... won’t the title of the most wicked and evil be stolen by the Great Demon...
Welcome, welcome~ You seem like a gentleman of distinguished taste! Are you heading to the top to take down the Architect too?
Here, take this! You’d better do your best and take out the Architect!
(whispering) Once the Architect’s dead, the treasures here will be much easier to find!
Shh——keep your voice down! Oh right, want me to hold onto your money before you set out? The interest rates I offer are pretty good~
I’ve heard that people near Miss Shion all become unlucky. I don’t think that’s scientifically sound.
(The moment Shion approaches the Regent’s throne, his servants lose their balance and fall, sending both the throne and the Regent tumbling to the ground.)
Alright... my worldview is now leaning a bit more towards idealism.
A construct? Did the Architect send you——
Joon... this one doesn’t seem hostile...
Hmm~ I heard the kappa’s robots sold like hotcakes in the village... maybe this one could too——
Ah, this one reeks of that blight. Looks like they’ve caught an incurable disease——
I may be a Pestilence God, but I can’t help you with that problem. Still, you can’t take money to the afterlife anyway—so how about I help you manage your assets?
Such strong negative energy——feels just like what my sister’s got——
What——impossible! My negative energy is the most vicious and malignant——whether in Gensokyo or in this wretched tower!
Ah, there goes my sister again——
...... I’m going to the top to kill the Architect. Can you stop bickering and lend me some help?
I heard you offer debt collection services?
That’s right! For those deadbeats who won’t pay up, these bejeweled fists of mine will beat the debts right out of them!
The one at the top... owes me a blood debt.
Whoa whoa—you want me to farm the Architect for gold? No way, no way—but I can spot you some support.
The Plague God and the Poverty God? What are you two doing in the Spire?
To protect the gold coins from devastation!
To unite all peoples within Gensokyo!
...I’ll note down that they’re here and report it to Lord Enma.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-TOUTETSU_YUUMA_ANCIENT.ta: [jitter]Heh heh...[/jitter] So someone actually comes. Are you here to feast on the fear, pleasure, grief, loathing, and resentment as well?

Ah—I smell the scent of cursed blood. It reminds me of the aroma of oil, so full of resentment and hatred... Heheheh.
[jitter]Heh heh[/jitter], a simple-minded brute like you...Kurokoma might just like you... Heheheh.
That burning, demon-cursed blood of yours... I just can’t get enough of it... Heheheh. What a shame I can’t taste it here.

TOUHOUANCIENTS-FUTATSUIWA_MAMIZOU_ANCIEN: Come to think of it, I’ve stored some special brew at Nidomitei. Care for a taste? Fair warning, it packs quite a punch.
